findings.title: T9 relies on enable_op_determinism without a fallback rule
findings.fix: Step 0: run the pre-change fixture twice and require equal hashes; if determinism raises, use TF_CUDNN_DETERMINISTIC/TF_DETERMINISTIC_OPS; if still nondeterministic, compare pre/post-refactor deform() in one process with max |diff| == 0.

findings.title: 9.4 lacks exact sbatch lines for compare_tta.py (template and linear-eval)
findings.fix: Give full sbatch -A qtim -p basic ... --wrap singularity exec ... lines for both comparisons and state compare_tta.py flags for both CSV layouts.

findings.title: spread_max_mm means max (linear) but p99 (deform)
findings.fix: Use spread_p99_mm for deform rows, empty for linear.
